text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The fruitful days fly by, and just like<n>that, our time
at summer camp comes<n>to a close.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: No, it ain't like that. Ya see, I made a<n>promise.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Once we're done with summer camp,<n>it's off to the
Sprinters Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll put all my hard work to the test<n>and score me a
big win!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Let's get back to training the second<n>we get back
to the academy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! But before we do, let's wrap up<n>our time at
camp with a party!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, we put summer camp<n>behind us and set
our sights on the<n>Sprinters Stakes!
